summary.headline: Rules for Determining the Hyleg
summary.text: Rules for determining the Hyleg in diurnal and nocturnal nativities: after the Sun or Moon, candidates include the ascendant and part of fortune, subject to angular or succedent placement, gendered signs or quarters, and aspect by a lord of the five essential dignities.
